prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable way to name one “best” dentist without knowing your case and priorities. For an implant, I’d start with a **board-certified periodontist or oral and maxillofacial surgeon**—especially if you may need bone grafting, a sinus lift, or full-arch work.

A Phoenix option to consider is **AZPerio**, which says its board-certified periodontists provide implant treatment at its Phoenix-area offices: [azperio.com/dental-implants](https://azperio.com/dental-implants/). For a surgical second opinion, **Dr. Amogh Velangi**, a board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeon with a Phoenix office, is another option: [ProMax Surgery](https://www.promaxsurgery.com/about-us/dr-amogh-velangi/).

Before choosing, get **two consultations** and ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what the full written cost includes, what alternatives exist, and how they handle complications and follow-up. Verify the clinician’s current credentials and check that your insurance and the office’s fees work for you.
